sourceProbe.recorderExtension: absent: no recorder VS Code/Cursor extension exists or is installed; no producer of dx.cursor-extension.activity.v1 on this host

feasibility: Supported route = a user-installed VS Code extension using public APIs (window.onDidChangeWindowState, workspace.onDidSaveTextDocument, window.onDidChangeActiveTextEditor, vscode.git extension API for branch/HEAD) appending JSONL records. This yields editor focus/save/branch activity only. Public extension API exposes no Cursor AI tokens, cost, requests or tool calls.
gaps: producer-not-installed: extension producer not built/shipped; readiness disabled; do not register
no-ai-usage-via-extension-api: tokens/cost/requests/tool calls unavailable from this route
no-ai-ownership: editor activity is not authorship evidence
events use kind 'other' with payload.category 'ide.activity' because contract v1 has no IDE activity kind (additive kind would be A03's call)

checks.result: 0 errors in B09 files; nonzero from other owners' files
